HOW TO USE THIS WORKBOOK
1. Make every new entry ONLY in the "Expense Statement" sheet, in the next empty row (capacity 1,000 rows).
2. Fill: Date (dd-mm-yyyy) • Expense Head (drop-down) • Item / Description • Payee (drop-down) • Qty & Unit (if material).
3. Basic Amount = value before GST as per bill (Qty × Rate). For labour / cash payments without GST, enter the full amount here.
4. GST Amount = GST shown on the bill (leave blank if no GST bill). Transport / Other = freight, loading, etc.
5. Total Amount, Rate/Unit, Month and S.No. are calculated automatically – do not type in grey columns.
6. Payment Status: Paid / Advance Paid / On Credit (Unpaid). Payment Mode: UPI (GPay) / Bank Transfer / Cash / Cheque.
7. Enter the UTR / UPI reference in "Transaction / UTR ID" and the bill number in "Bill / Invoice No.".
8. Upload the bill to Drive, then right-click "Bill Link" cell → Link → paste the link; set Bill Status = Uploaded.
9. The "Entry Check" column must show OK. Red = missing data; Yellow = Txn ID not entered.
10. Dashboard, Head-wise Register, Vendor Register and Pending & Credit update automatically.
11. To add a new Expense Head, Payee or Unit, type it in a yellow blank cell of the list on the "Masters" sheet.
12. Enter the work order / budget value in Masters!N7 to see the budget balance on the Dashboard.
